dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: Even if we find a calm place to think, we will inevitably be interrupted by noisy students.

dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: To be honest, I was never interested in these celebratory events or competitions when I was in the Akademiya.

dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: Winning the Championship doesn't really help add any credit to your research, and any renown gained from it only amounts to some short-lived attention.

dialogues.speaker: Homayun
dialogues.text: ...Realistically speaking, there are few people as practical as I am.
